author: nyx+znq19+萧洋
description: Lets KiraAI genuinely use a browser. Does almost everything you can do in a browser: open pages, read content, click, type, upload and download files, run JavaScript, carry logins across, and even drive the keyboard and mouse. With the bundled extension it works inside the browser you already have open (your logins, no conflict); without it, it spins up its own headless browser - both paths do exactly the same things.

zh.description: 让 KiraAI 真正会用浏览器。人在浏览器里能做的事，它基本都能做：打开网页、读懂内容、点击、输入、上传下载、执行 JavaScript、搬运登录状态，键盘鼠标也能模拟。装了配套扩展就用你自己开着的浏览器（登录状态现成、互不打扰），没装就用它自带的无头浏览器 —— 两条路能力完全一样。
